data.description:

* Analyze loss curves and rollout traces to identify reward hacking, convergence issues, and flawed verifier specifications.
* Audit tasks and multi-turn environments for realism, threat accuracy, and dataset balance.

data.description:

* Build and run alignment evaluations that test for risks not captured by current benchmarks.
* Conduct pre-deployment testing of AI systems and report findings to frontier AI companies and governments.
* Design and develop software and tooling to improve alignment evaluation efficiency and usability.
* Contribute to publications and technical reports advancing the field's understanding of misalignment risks.
data.summary: Research and evaluate misalignment in frontier AI systems to understand loss-of-control risks such as research sabotage and reward-seeking.

* Develop risk scenarios then build and run evals end to end against frontier models.
* Design evaluation methods turning risk scenarios into rigorous, defensible measurements.
* Perform literature reviews, investigate model behaviour, and red-team your evals.
* Write findings clearly for regulators and co-author papers and technical reports.
data.summary: Design and build novel evaluations of AI harmful manipulation for EU AI Act enforcement.
